records.name: Kulu Mele African Dance & Drum Ensemble
records.summary: An African dance and drumming group that teaches classes for beginners and experienced dancers and drummers. It also stages public concerts and community events.
records.what_you_do: Take a dance or drum class, or come to the public concerts and community events such as the Juneteenth Jubilee and Odunde.

schedule.text: Classes for dancers and drummers, with end of year performances. Class times are not on the page.

cost.text: Not listed on the page. Concert tickets are sold through Eventbrite.

first_step.how: Email info@kulumele.org or call 484.929.7353 to ask about the next beginner class
first_step.basis: Classes are described as open to beginners, but the page does not say how to enroll.

records.notes: No month or year is published for the listed events (the youth concert gives a day and month only, June 1). The only year is the copyright footer, which does not count. Status is probably_active because the site works but shows no dated evidence. Email address kulumele@kulumele.org also appears on the page.

records.name: La Salle University Art Museum
records.summary: The art museum of La Salle University. It serves the general public and offers school gallery lessons, guided tours and outreach.
records.what_you_do: Visit the galleries, join a gallery lesson or guided tour, or come to a museum event. The page lists no volunteer roles.

first_step.how: Check the Gallery Tours and Events and Activities pages on the museum site for times and how to book
first_step.basis: Public tours and lessons are listed, but the details were not readable on this check, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: Only the homepage was read. Hours, address and contacts sit on linked pages that were not followed. The Last updated 10/07/2026 note refers to the collections database, so it is not counted as evidence. Status is probably_active because the site works but shows no dated events. painting_drawing is the closest tag for a collection of fine art.

records.name: Leonard Pearlstein Gallery at Drexel University
records.summary: A free art gallery at Drexel University that shows changing exhibitions. The gallery says it is open to all visitors.
records.what_you_do: Visit the free exhibitions during gallery hours. The page points to an Opportunities section and a call for proposals for artists, but gives no volunteer details.

schedule.text: Tuesday to Friday, 12 pm to 5 pm, and Saturday, 12 pm to 6 pm, starting October 13, 2026.

locations.label: Gallery
locations.address: URBN Annex, 3401 Filbert Street, Philadelphia, PA 19104

first_step.how: Visit during gallery hours to see the current exhibition, Escape > Control > Play
first_step.basis: The site calls the gallery free and open to visitors, so a first visit needs no sign-up.

records.notes: The phone number is the general Drexel University line, not a gallery line. Status is active because of posted hours starting October 2026 and a current exhibition; no event dates were visible. Opportunities and call for proposals pages were linked but not followed.
